authentication: none in practice; an API key is optional and only raises the documented daily limit and the count-bucket cap
free_tier: free; unauthenticated requests work, documented limits 240 requests/minute and 1,000 requests/day per IP
rate_limits: 240 req/min, 1,000 req/day per IP without a key; 240 req/min, 120,000 req/day with a free key (documented on open.fda.gov/apis/authentication/)
licence: public domain / CC0 1.0 Universal dedication (openFDA device recall data); FDA website content is public domain unless otherwise noted
update_frequency: weekly (API metadata last_updated observed as 2026-11-05 at probe time)
historical_coverage: 2002 to present per the API key facts (weekly updates); the API caps skip at 25,000 so a full-history pull needs date windows
known_limitations: A recall record is one enforcement action, NOT a failure rate: there is no exposure denominator and FDA seeks publicity selectively.
event_date_* fields exist on device/recall; the drug-enforcement report_date / center_classification_date fields are absent and must not be assumed (verified from a real response).
event_date_posted (public visibility) is later than event_date_initiated (event), so recall evidence cannot anticipate the event it reports; it can only be used as a lagging confirmation.
FDA does not keep updating recall status after classification, so recall_status/termination is administrative, not a safety verdict.
The API caps skip at 25,000, so an unfiltered full-history pull needs a date window rather than deep paging.
recalling_firm is a free-text submitter string, not a legal entity id; parent/subsidiary resolution must be done locally and candidates must not be promoted.
research_value: Gives MedRadar a dated, regulator-published recall clock per device firm: event_date_initiated supports event-time alignment and event_date_posted supports a defensible public-visibility clock. It fills the postmarket 'confirmed harm / corrective action' gap that clearance-only data cannot show, and it is the highest-quality lagging label for the five target firms.
cost_notes: free; no registration required; polite serial access at >= 0.9 s interval used by this project
